subject: Run GGIR in cluster, lost last file

messages.author: a0c9c53065dc7f03
messages.subject: Run GGIR in cluster, lost last file
parts:
Dear all,
I run GGIR in cluster. First, I run mode=1 for each subset of the data by setting up f0 and f1. Then, I run mode=2,3,4 for all files together. I found the last file was not reported in part2.summary. I tried this three times and I always lost the last file, which has been obtained by other colleague. 

Is there anybody who has the same issue with me?
Thanks.
Wei
